command: Graphviz.layout(<file with size="12.5,9.375!" as its last statement, each fontname as its sizing family>, "svg", "twopi")
fonts: Graphviz in WebAssembly has no fonts: each fontname is laid out as the built-in width table nearest the face Chromium draws the fontname in, as graphty-element chooses it (graphvizFamilyFor): {"URW Chancery L, Apple Chancery, Comic Sans MS, cursive":"Times"}

canvas.requested: fit within 1200 x 900 px (size="12.5,9.375!", 96 px per inch)

svgPostprocessing: a font-family naming no generic family gets sans-serif after it, the face Graphviz measured it in; otherwise Graphviz's output byte for byte
